summary: vectorIndexConfig int params have an inconsistent validation surface on POST /v1/schema: ef=-5/0, vectorCacheMaxObjects=-1, cleanupIntervalSeconds=-1, pq.centroids=-1 are accepted and persisted (HTTP 200, response echoes, GET read-back confirms), while maxConnections=-1 and efConstruction=-5 on the same config object are rejected 422 (min-constraint). ef is the active HNSW search-time param whose documented default sentinel is -1; -5/0 are invalid values silently persisted (R2 numeric-boundary extension of R1 type_mismatch finding on dynamicEfMin/Max/flatSearchCutoff).
